# Tests

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_tests_readme.py from the test code. Do not edit by hand. -->

87 test cases (72 test functions) and 178 assertions. All run offline: the portal is mocked, either at the HTTP level (`aioresponses`) or by replacing the client.

```sh
uv sync                                  # install the pinned dev tools
uv run pytest                            # run all tests
uv run pytest tests/test_sensor.py -k best_soc
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
uv run python tools/gen_tests_readme.py  # regenerate this file
```

| File | Covers | Cases | Asserts |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| [test_api.py](#test_apipy) | Portal client: login flows, HTTP handling and dataset parsing (runs without Home Assistant). | 37 | 46 |
| [test_config_flow.py](#test_config_flowpy) | Config, reauth and options flows. | 11 | 26 |
| [test_coordinator.py](#test_coordinatorpy) | Coordinator: persistence, partial failures and repair issues. | 8 | 26 |
| [test_diagnostics.py](#test_diagnosticspy) | Diagnostics download. | 1 | 8 |
| [test_init.py](#test_initpy) | Setup, unload and removal of a config entry. | 7 | 27 |
| [test_sensor.py](#test_sensorpy) | Sensor and binary sensor entities. | 23 | 45 |

Shared fixtures live in [conftest.py](conftest.py): a mocked `DataActClient` for setup (`mock_client`) and for the config flow (`flow_client`), a `config_entry`, and helpers that fill a vehicle with sample data points.
